author: Sho
body:
Gonna be getting back into Avicus. Yeh. 

Played in 2 OCN tournaments, Hoc w/ my own team Chinatown and Gotw with AFT. 

In avicus teams I've been given an open invite to iloominatey.

Most regulars have my skype. I'd like to keep it off public forum. 

If you are concerned about my maturity I'm 18 so I hope that clarifies your doubts. 

I can defend (for DTC, DTM and CTW) and play support. 

You can view my badlion stats and kohi stats if you want. 

Timezone is a pain sometimes. GMT+8 but i'm flexible.
